intent: The periodic setup replaces live /usr/local/bin scripts by atomic rename, so a running hosts-file-monitor never executes a half-written file.
scope: Non-goal: re-running the installer on the host
changes: install_rendered_script renders to a temp file beside the target, bash -n, chmod/chown, mv -f
Maintenance script, hosts monitor, browser wrapper and auto-update script use it

verification.evidence: red against in-place write (inode kept, old fd saw new bytes), 12 passed after
real hosts-file-monitor template under systemd: inode 85520 -> 85524, MainPID 745 -> 768, service active

risks: Temp file left in /usr/local/bin if the installer is killed between mktemp and mv
Restart briefly interrupts the hosts monitor
rollback: git revert the commit; the old installer overwrites in place again
